details: Dev-only deterministic reporting dataset for 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31.
Do not run against production. This reset wipes travelers and transactional business data only.
Invoice total = sum(final_receivable) per invoice. Balance due = invoice total - total received.
Balance due = max(total invoice amount - cumulative invoice receipts, 0).
Air-ticket commission is stored separately. Current service profit remains final_receivable - payable under existing system logic.
Non-air subtype detail tables are populated by a tiny demo-only direct SQL helper because current repository persistence is air-ticket-first.
